description: This Java source file defines the DataTableValidator class, responsible for validating data table registration requests and advanced query requests within the Fineract project. It includes methods for schema validation, parameter checks, and ensuring the correctness of complex query data structures.

classes.name: DataTableValidator
classes.description: A validator class used for validating data table registration inputs and complex search query structures, ensuring parameters are supported and correctly formatted.

methods.name: validateDataTableRegistration
methods.description: Validates the JSON payload for data table registration, checking for unsupported parameters and validating the category parameter value.

methods.name: validateTableSearch
methods.description: Validates advanced query requests, including individual table queries and their associated query data.

methods.name: validateTableSearch
methods.description: Overloaded method that validates an individual AdvancedQueryData object for correct structure and contents.

methods.name: validateQueryData
methods.description: Performs detailed validation of an AdvancedQueryData object, ensuring column filters, filters, operators, and result columns are correctly specified.
